svg.title: Free radical chain polymerisation mechanism
svg.desc: Initiation by homolysis of an initiator and addition to a monomer, propagation, and termination by combination and by disproportionation, drawn with half-headed (fishhook) curved arrows.
svg.text: 1. Initiation (a): homolysis of the initiator (rate-determining, kd)
1. Initiation (b): radical adds to the monomer (ki)
2. Propagation: head-to-tail addition repeated n times (kp)
HX (growing chain; active centre moves to the new chain end)
3. Termination (kt): two growing chains destroy each other
(b) Disproportionation: DP = ν (one chain gives H to the other)
saturated chain end + unsaturated (C=C) chain end; ν = kinetic chain length = R
Chain transfer (not shown) to monomer, solvent or polymer lowers M and may give branches. Inhibitors/retarders scavenge R• or P•.
